Now that a cache's min_partial has been moved to struct kmem_cache
possible to easily tune it from userspace by adding a sysfs attribute.
It may not be desirable to keep a large number of partial slabs around
if a cache is used infrequently and memory
by a cgroup

column1: minimum policy per cache instead of relying explicitly on

(unless maybe you're from SGI or something)
